name: manual_ce342a
claim: A git worktree's core.hooksPath can drift to an absolute path instead of the repo-relative .githooks, breaking any hook-verification script that does a strict string-equality check against '.githooks'

decisions.notes: scripts/git/ensure_hooks_installed.sh does '[[ "$hooks_path" != ".githooks" ]]' and failed commits twice in one session with 'core.hooksPath=$REPO_ROOT/.githooks — expected .githooks' inside worktrees. Fixed both times with 'git config core.hooksPath .githooks' (a config correction, not a hook bypass) before retrying the commit.
